card.name: Last digit of verse numbers
card.fires_on: The final digit of a two-digit chapter or verse number inside a scripture citation such as Mk. 8:35 or Jn. 12:46. It also fires weakly on the last digit of other number pairs, such as fractions.

modes.label: Bible verse digits
modes.description: The last digit of a verse number after a colon in a Bible citation.

modes.label: Other number pairs
modes.description: The last digit of a number in a fraction, ratio or date.
